user.title: Connect Matter Reflex
user.description: Select the commissioned board. Home Assistant checks whether the Matter server can transfer rules.

esphome.title: Set up encrypted rules transfer
esphome.description: Select the ESPHome board with an encrypted API. The lease and device commands use Matter.

error.cannot_connect: Check the board identity, encrypted ESPHome connection and Thread connectivity.
error.matter_unavailable: Cannot reach the node over Matter. Check its availability and retry.
error.lease_unsupported: Matter Server cannot renew the lease with this firmware. Verify that the board runs Reflex firmware 1.3.0 or later and that this controller has administrator access to it. After a firmware update, re-interview the board in Matter Server to discover its Actions cluster, then retry.

abort.no_nodes: No commissioned Matter Reflex node found on the fabric.
abort.no_esphome: Add the board to the ESPHome integration with an encrypted API and the reflex_exchange action, then retry.

lease.title: Matter Reflex lease unavailable
lease.description: {detail} Verify that the board runs Reflex firmware 1.3.0 or later and that this controller has administrator access to it. After a firmware update, re-interview the board in Matter Server to discover its Actions cluster, then retry.

mode.name: Reflex mode
mode.description: Choose who handles this automation. Requires the reflex label.

handlers.name: Reflex handlers (advanced)
handlers.description: Choose normal and degraded handlers independently. Requires the reflex label.
